identity_or_measurement_required: observed as-fitted raised case mark 25050; still require donor model/year, complete part or casting identity, RHD orientation, mount pattern, input spline, sector spline, port threads, overall envelope, condition
pass_rule: one exact rebuildable/verified box is identified and photographed with measurements; raised 25050 alone does not prove donor application

identity_or_measurement_required: part identity, sector compatibility, clocking, centre distance, drop/offset, ball-joint or drag-link interface
pass_rule: arm is proven matched to selected box and clears frame/spring through lock-to-lock

identity_or_measurement_required: rail dimensions/thickness, existing holes/repairs, actual J80 bolt centres, sleeve and tool access
pass_rule: new full-size J40-to-J80 template fits actual box and sound frame; J60 pattern is not reused by assumption

identity_or_measurement_required: J40 column lower support, J80 input spline, joint ratings/angles, shaft plunge, firewall support
pass_rule: supported double-joint layout has adequate collapse/plunge and no bind through engine movement

identity_or_measurement_required: ride-height centre distance, both end tapers/threads, joint angles, adjustment, bump/rebound and lock-to-lock sweep
pass_rule: matched/custom link runs without bind/contact and produces required full steering travel

identity_or_measurement_required: pump identity, flow, pressure, relief, fluid, bracket rigidity, pulley plane, belt wrap and service path
pass_rule: pump specification is compatible with exact J80 box and pulleys align under load

identity_or_measurement_required: box port threads, pump outlet, reservoir height/capacity, hose ratings, bend radii, heat and movement
pass_rule: rated hoses use correct ends and remain clear/cool/serviceable lock-to-lock

identity_or_measurement_required: box/shaft/pitman/port/hose/bolt/tool envelope plus 340 x 265 tray and 300 x 205 battery footprint
pass_rule: current battery/tray orientation clears all steering/service envelopes; battery-only 90-degree rotation is rejected because 300 mm exceeds the 265 mm tray side; any whole-carrier turn separately proves a 265 x 340 bay envelope plus bonnet, terminal, cable and lift-out clearance
release_effect: allows carrier holes to be locked

identity_or_measurement_required: manifold/turbo/downpipe/heat-shield envelopes, engine roll, steering hoses and shaft
pass_rule: no contact or unsafe heat exposure at full steering travel and engine movement

identity_or_measurement_required: fastener marks/torques, hose flush/bleed, leak check, lock-to-lock, return to centre, bump steer and road test
pass_rule: independent inspection and controlled low-speed/load test pass
